name: What should I do immediately after a fire to prevent smoke smell from worsening?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after a fire to prevent smoke smell from worsening?

acceptedAnswer.text: After ensuring it is safe to enter, ventilate the property by opening windows and doors. Remove any charred or heavily smoke-damaged items that are salvageable, and dispose of non-salvageable items promptly. Avoid running your HVAC system if it circulated smoke. Contacting a professional restoration company quickly is crucial, as early intervention can significantly reduce the long-term impact of smoke odor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ventilate the property, remove damaged items, avoid running HVAC, and contact a professional restoration company quickly to prevent the smoke smell from worsening.
